rowSemantics: One row represents one independent editing task instance (source_id) paired with native authentic image and canonical edited variant (variant 0 of bbox inpainting), with metadata tracking all 6 edited variants and 10 masks.

relationship4104vs6156.explanation: 6,156 is the total number of uncompressed image files on disk across Option P. It consists of 2,052 authentic images (684 instances x 3 resolutions: native, 512, 1024) and 4,104 AI-edited images (684 instances x 6 variants: 3 bbox inpaintings + 3 segm inpaintings). The manifest_pilot_a_option_p.csv contains 684 paired instance rows. Expanding each instance to its 6 edited variants produces exactly 4,104 paired samples in manifest_pilot_a_variant_pairs.csv.
